document_host.note: Separate host. RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DC&FOLDER1_REF=<n> returns a real page but zero rows to a plain HTTP client; rows arrive over $.connection.publicAccessHub. Files would come from /AniteIM.WebSearch/Document/ViewDocument, but the ids only come from the hub.

quirks.summary: Documents are on a separate AniteIM host and its listing is delivered over a SignalR hub, so no plain-HTTP client can enumerate them.
quirks.detail: Verified 2026-09-29. The Idox register has no documents tab -- only activeTab=externalDocuments, which carries a link to https://pad-planning.bury.gov.uk/AniteIM.WebSearch/ExternalEntryPoint.aspx?SEARCH_TYPE=1&DOC_CLASS_CODE=DC&FOLDER1_REF=<n>. That redirects to SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DC&FOLDER1_REF=<n>, which returns HTTP 200 and a real page ('Documents for reference <n>') but ZERO document rows to curl: the rows arrive over $.connection.publicAccessHub (jquery.signalR-2.4.2) and render client-side. Files are served from /AniteIM.WebSearch/Document/ViewDocument, but the ids come from the hub. FOLDER1_REF is an internal id, not the planning reference, and must be scraped from the externalDocuments tab.
quirks.workaround: Scrape FOLDER1_REF from the externalDocuments tab and hand the user the ExternalEntryPoint URL. Do not attempt the SignalR negotiation.

quirks.summary: Constructing applicationDetails.do?activeTab=documents returns HTTP 500 here, because this install has no documents tab.
quirks.detail: Seen 2026-09-29. A constructed documents-tab URL 500s while the summary page 200s, which reads as a portal fault. Read the tab list off the summary page instead of assuming the tab exists.
quirks.workaround: GET activeTab=summary first and take the real tab links from it.
